If the target is oneself, a saved messages channel is returned.

endpoints.title: Fetch Linked Accounts
endpoints.description: Your linked accounts, and which services can be linked on this server.

endpoints.title: Disconnect a Service
endpoints.description: Removes the link and everything copied from the service, at once.

endpoints.title: Edit Linked Service Account
endpoints.description: Show or hide it on your profile; for GitHub, choose the repositories. `consent` agrees to the consent text in use (its exact version number).

endpoints.title: Finish Linking a Service
endpoints.description: Swaps the code the service sent back for a token, reads who the person is with it, and drops it. A new link starts hidden: it shows on the profile only after the person checked the preview. Signing in again with the same account keeps their choices (Battle.net: confirms again).

endpoints.title: Refresh Linked Service Account
endpoints.description: GitHub only: read the public repositories again. Once every 10 minutes. (Twitch updates by itself; Battle.net is confirmed by signing in again.) A link agreed under an older consent text must agree to the current one first (`consent` in Edit).

endpoints.title: Start Linking a Service
endpoints.description: Returns the service's own sign-in page (`twitch`, `github` or `battlenet`). The service sends the person back to `<origin>/connections/<service>/return`; the web app then calls Finish.

endpoints.title: Disconnect Steam
endpoints.description: Removes the link and everything copied from Steam, at once.

endpoints.title: Edit Linked Steam Account
endpoints.description: Show or hide it on your profile, and choose games not to show.

endpoints.title: Finish Linking Steam
endpoints.description: Checks what Steam sent back, with Steam, then copies what the account shows publicly. The link starts hidden: it shows on the profile only after the person checked the preview.

endpoints.title: Refresh Linked Steam Account
endpoints.description: Copy again what the Steam account shows publicly. Once every 10 minutes. A link agreed under an older consent text must agree to the current one first (`consent` in Edit): Refresh sends the Steam id to Valve in the US.

endpoints.title: Start Linking Steam
endpoints.description: Returns Steam's own sign-in page. Steam sends the person back to `<origin>/connections/steam/return`; the web app then calls Finish.
